Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.label: summon Shardblade
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.description: Will your spren into blade form. For a Radiant of the Third Ideal or higher, the weapon appears in a flash of mist, solid and familiar in the hand. Dead Shardblades are different. They require ten heartbeats, each one heavy with intention, before the blade will answer.
